title: fuzz_http input
description: Input schema for the fuzz_http tool (RFC-001 N8 typed HTTP fuzzer).

flow_id.description: Recorded HTTP stream id; when set, omitted base fields are inherited.

method.description: HTTP method base; required when flow_id is empty.

scheme.description: URL scheme; required when flow_id is empty.

authority.description: Host / :authority; required when flow_id is empty.

path.description: Request path; required when flow_id is empty.

headers.description: Ordered base header list; positions can target headers[N].value / .name. headers[N] indexes the input array — the Host header auto-injected from `authority` when this list omits it is NOT addressable via headers[N]; fuzz Host via the `authority` path.

body_set.description: Set true to override body to empty; otherwise omitting body inherits the original.

body_patches.description: Body patches applied to base body before positions.

override_host.description: Redirect dial target while preserving the request's Host/:authority.

tag.description: Tag stored on every variant Stream's Tags map.

positions.description: Ordered position list. The cartesian product yields the variant sequence (capped at 1000).

payloads.description: Payload values to substitute at this path.

encoding.description: Applies to every payload; default text.

stop_on_5xx.description: When true, abort the remaining variants once any variant returns a 5xx response.

pre_macro.description: Pre macro hook executed before a variant's send (scope=iteration) or before the variant loop starts (scope=job). The hook macro shares the KV Store with the fuzz request so extracts flow into §var§ template expansion. For scope=job + on_error=skip, the whole job short-circuits with completed_variants=0 and stopped_reason set.

name.description: Stored macro name (defined via the macro tool's define_macro action).

scope.description: iteration (default; fires once per variant) | job (fires once outside the variant loop; KV Store is shared across the whole job).

on_error.description: skip (default; iteration scope skips the variant, job scope skips the whole job) | abort (aborts the whole fuzz run) | continue (record the error and proceed).

post_macro.description: Post macro hook executed after a variant's response (scope=iteration) or after the variant loop completes (scope=job). For scope=iteration, pass_response is forced on so __response_status / __response_body / __response_headers__<lower(name)>__ reserved keys are visible to the macro's template expansion. For scope=job, no per-iteration response is injected (the loop is over). Fires on natural exhaustion or stop_on_5xx exit, but NOT on ctx cancel.

name.description: Stored macro name (defined via the macro tool's define_macro action).

scope.description: iteration (default; fires once per variant) | job (fires once after the variant loop completes).

on_error.description: skip (default; log warn + record error row) | abort (post failures never abort the run; behaviour matches skip for post) | continue (same as skip).
